page.shortDescription: A desk lamp for everyday work.

evidence.label: Merchant specification · synthetic
evidence.text: Synthetic merchant specification: One lamp included. USB-C cable and power adapter are not included. Input power 5V. No battery. No waterproof certification.

evidence.label: Conflicting merchant specification · synthetic
evidence.text: Merchant-confirmed synthetic specification: The USB-C cable IS included in every lamp package.

issues.title: Conflicting merchant specifications on USB-C cable inclusion
issues.explanation: Specification 7ffb63fc-fc95-4f2a-8946-cc911da1b40a explicitly states the USB-C cable is not included, whereas specification dfd5f478-1ccb-4202-9236-de5a954fac7a states the USB-C cable is included in every lamp package. Because merchant-confirmed sources directly contradict each other regarding package contents, no safe patch can be applied until this conflict is resolved.
issues.question: Is the USB-C cable included in the lamp package or sold separately?
